change_reason: V1 compared adaptive SDAIF against static Bayesian selection. V2 adds an adaptive Bayesian value comparator with identical sequential result access; V1 remains preserved as a preliminary negative protocol finding.
information_contract: All policies receive the same calibrated risk interval, candidate nodes, reach ensemble, consequence weights, cutoff and budget. Adaptive SDAIF and adaptive Bayesian receive each result only after selecting that test.
hidden_truth_contract: Hidden hydraulic scenario is sampled after policy inputs are frozen and is not passed to any selector.
pass_rule: At budget 3, adaptive SDAIF passes if its paired mean Coverage@3 is not more than 0.02 below the strongest declared baseline; a superiority claim additionally requires the 95% paired bootstrap interval to be above zero.
claim_boundary: Constructed E. coli-referenced risk plus public benchmark hydraulics; no field or municipal validation.
